Cost: 0eb

An open-source freeware app passed around Edgerunner circles. Includes access to a edgerunner forum and helps locate fixers. While free, the app isn't widely availible. The only way to get access to it you have to be invited by an existing member that trusts you enough to put their reputation at risk if you end up being a gonk. Usually this happens once a character reaches a Reputation of 5 or higher. A character's access is revoked if their Reputation dips below 2.

Adds +2 to Streetwise.

Foundry notes:

  • An app runs on a Neuroport or an Agent and does nothing without one (see the House Rules journal). Keep it in the inventory while the character has either.
  • The +2 to Streetwise applies automatically. The Reputation requirement is not.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Apps).
